Hero.parrafo: High-end lighting pieces sculpted from ancient reclaimed wood.
Hero.subParrafo: Timeless art and organic soul preserved in numbered pieces of exclusive design.

Editorial.descripcion: We don't just create lamps; we sculpt time. Each piece of wood is selected for its scars and grain, transforming under our hands into a light source that breathes serenity into your home.

Garantias.g1Texto: Each work is delivered signed by the author with a physical document certifying its unique serial number and botanical species.
Garantias.g2Texto: We meticulously prepare high-protection technical packaging for each lamp, ensuring an impeccable presentation.
Garantias.g3Texto: Your piece is shipped with full insurance and personalized tracking. We take care of every detail until the piece is part of your home, ensuring complete security and peace of mind.

Manifiesto.p1: Our works begin far from commercial noise. We look for woods that have already lived: pieces sculpted by the sea on the coast, fallen branches in the forest, or remains from controlled and fully ethical pruning.
Manifiesto.p2: Each log or root begins a lethargy of months on our workbench to ensure its natural stability. Only then, through manual sanitation and components in solid brass and natural fabric shades, do we release the latent light within its grain.

Encargos.titulo: Looking for a bespoke project or technical advice?
Encargos.texto: We work hand in hand with interior designers, architects, and private collectors to conceive exclusive pieces adapted to singular spaces.

Header.titulo: From the secret of nature to the warmth of the home
Header.descripcion: Each Veta & Lux lamp is not manufactured; it is listened to and released. We follow an honest, unhurried process that is deeply respectful of the cycles of time.

Fase1.p1: Our raw material does not come from commercial logging. We look for pieces with history: driftwood sculpted by the sea salt on the coast or fallen branches in ancient forests from controlled and fully legal pruning.
Fase1.p2: We seek woods that have already lived, paying special attention to their knots and scars. The video evokes the natural environment where each story is born.

Fase2.p1: Living wood retains moisture and tension. Upon arrival at the workshop, each piece begins a period of absolute rest that can last for months in our space.
Fase2.p2: They stabilize naturally, allowing the fiber to settle. It is an exercise in patience where we determine if the structure is fit to hold light and endure for generations.

Fase3.p1: We remove the weakened parts manually using planes and gouges, strictly respecting the healthy bark, textures, and stable cracks that give character to the piece.
Fase3.p2: We treat the wood using non-invasive techniques and apply texturized organic oils by hand up to a 1000 grain, nourishing the pore without hiding the pure, marble-like feel of the wood.

Fase4.p1: A premium lamp requires impeccable electronics. We design hidden internal channels down to the millimeter so as not to alter the organic aesthetics of the log.
Fase4.p2: We exclusively use cables with subtle natural linen or textile cotton sheaths, solid brass lamp holders, and electrical systems that comply with the strictest European safety standards.

Cierre.cita: "We do not create two identical pieces because nature never repeats the same stroke. Bringing one of our lamps into your space is adopting a fragment of suspended time."

Coleccion.descripcion: Table and pendant lamps carved by hand from reclaimed wood. Every piece is unique: once it is sold, it is gone. If you like a style that has already sold, we can make a similar one to order.

p1.pregunta: How much is shipping and how long does it take?
p1.respuesta: Shipping to mainland Spain is free and takes 1–2 working days. To the Balearic and Canary Islands, Ceuta and Melilla it costs €25, and we confirm the delivery time when we prepare it. To France, Italy, Germany and Portugal it costs €65 and takes 3–5 working days. For other destinations, <contacto>get in touch</contacto> before ordering.

p2.respuesta: Yes. You have 14 calendar days from delivery. It must come back in its original packaging and in the same condition. Return shipping is at your expense, and we refund the price and the original shipping cost. Made-to-order pieces cannot be returned. Full details in <envios>shipping and returns</envios>.

p3.respuesta: By credit or debit card, or by bank transfer. If you choose bank transfer, the piece is reserved for 48 hours while we wait for payment. If it does not arrive in that time, the piece becomes available again.

p4.pregunta: How does such a delicate piece travel?
p4.respuesta: We pack it by hand in the workshop, in a box made to fit it, and ship it with tracking and signature on delivery.

p5.pregunta: I like a piece that has already sold. Can you make another?
p5.respuesta: Every piece is unique and never repeated, because no two pieces of wood are alike. But we can make you a similar one, choosing the wood, size and shade or bulb with you. See how <medida>made-to-order lamps</medida> work.

Cookies.seccion1_texto: A cookie is a small text file that is downloaded automatically to your device (computer, smartphone, or tablet) when you access the vast majority of websites. They allow a site, among other things, to store and retrieve information about a user's browsing habits to recognize them and offer an optimal and personalized service.

Taller.intro: Veta & Lux began with two friends who discovered they shared the same passions: craftsmanship, wood, DIY and respect for nature.
historia: When we made our first wooden lamps, we realised we could give pride of place to something that was being lost. The result amazed us, and we wanted to share it with the world.
We also saw that it was nothing like what you find in shops, where almost everything is mass-produced and feels impersonal. This was different and original, and above all, we loved making it.

personas.texto: Web developer with a passion for nature and woodworking. She set up her own workshop at home and decided to devote herself fully to Veta & Lux to help build a more sustainable world.
Forest firefighter. His work has given him a deep respect for nature, and he has found some of the wood we use after his firefighting work.

Taller.manosTexto: We look for the wood, work it, finish it, assemble each lamp and prepare its packaging. We put the utmost care and detail into every piece, as if it were for ourselves.

NoEncontrada.texto: The piece may no longer be listed or the link may have changed. Here are a few ways to carry on.

Materiales.respuesta: All the wood at Veta & Lux is reclaimed: we do not fell trees to make lamps. We find it fallen in the forest, as driftwood at river and stream mouths, in areas burned by wildfires and in ruined houses, or we buy it as firewood from controlled pruning. Before working it, we treat it against insects and dry it in our warehouse until it reaches the right moisture level.

procedencias.texto: Trunks and branches from trees that fell on their own. We collect wood the forest has already let go of, in the shape the tree gave it.
Wood carried by the water down to the mouth of rivers and streams: what is known as driftwood. The current and the sand polish and round it over the years.
Wood from trees affected by wildfires. Rafa is a forest firefighter and has found many of these pieces after a fire.
Fallen beams left behind in ruined houses, which we recover before they are lost. Timber that once held up a home.
We buy firewood from controlled pruning and hand-pick the pieces with the most character, which would otherwise end up in a fireplace.

pasos.texto: We choose each piece for its shape, grain and condition. If the wood is not fit to last, we do not use it.
We apply treatments against woodworm and other insects, preventively and, when needed, curatively.
The wood rests in our warehouse until it reaches the right moisture level. It can take months, which is why we always have dry, treated wood ready to work.
We remove weakened parts by hand and apply the finish, keeping the textures and stable cracks that give each piece its character.

Materiales.maderasTexto: Olive, eucalyptus, chestnut, oak, walnut and pine. Each product page names the wood of the piece and, when we know it, its origin.

faq.pregunta: Do you fell trees to make your lamps?
faq.respuesta: No. We only work with reclaimed wood: fallen trees, wood carried by rivers and streams, wood from wildfires, beams from ruined houses and firewood from controlled pruning.

Yes, as long as the wood is sound, treated and dry. Every piece is treated against insects, dried in our warehouse to the right moisture level, and we remove weakened parts by hand before turning it into a lamp.
We treat the wood against woodworm and other insects, preventively and curatively, before drying and working it.

faq.pregunta: Why are no two lamps the same?
faq.respuesta: Because every piece of wood has its own shape, grain and marks. We design each lamp around the piece in front of us, which is why every one comes numbered with its certificate of authenticity.

faq.pregunta: Can I know where the wood in a specific lamp comes from?
faq.respuesta: Yes. Each product page describes the wood and its origin when we know it. If you have questions about a piece, get in touch.
